new_scholarship.description: The Study in India (SII) programme is a flagship project of the Government of India executed by the Ministry of Education, and the SII Scholarship is the financial-assistance component attached to it. new_scholarship.description: The POSCO Global Scholarship in Korea is the inbound component of the POSCO Global Scholarship operated by the POSCO TJ Park Foundation, and it is described by the Foundation as 'The Global Future Leaders Scholarship Program'. It funds non-Korean nationals admitted to Master's or doctoral programmes at designated Korean graduate schools, who must be recommended by their admitting institution. Master's students receive full tuition for four semesters plus living expenses of KRW 1,000,000 per month for 22 months, while doctoral and integrated master's-doctoral students receive full tuition for six semesters plus the same monthly living allowance for 36 months. A one-off KRW 1,000,000 settlement fee, National Health Insurance premiums and Korean language and cultural programmes are also provided.

new_scholarship.description: MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships support researchers holding a PhD who wish to carry out their research activities abroad, acquire new skills and develop their careers. There are two types: European Postdoctoral Fellowships, lasting 12 to 24 months in an EU Member State or Horizon Europe Associated Country and open to any nationality; and Global Postdoctoral Fellowships, lasting an outgoing phase of 12 to 24 months in a non-associated Third Country followed by a mandatory 12-month return phase, open only to nationals or long-term residents of EU Member States or Horizon Europe Associated Countries. The researcher is recruited by a host organisation, which submits the proposal through the EU Funding and Tender Opportunities Portal, and receives a living allowance, a mobility allowance and, where applicable, family, long-term leave and special needs allowances. The 2026 call closed on 9 September 2026 and the 2027 call opens on 7 April 2027 with a deadline of 8 September 2027, both indicative.

new_scholarship.description: Erasmus+ helps organise student and doctoral candidate exchanges within countries fully part of the Erasmus+ programme and to and from countries associated to Erasmus+. It is open to short-cycle, Bachelor's and Master's students and to doctoral candidates registered at a participating higher education institution and enrolled in studies leading to a recognised degree. new_scholarship.description: France Excellence-Major is a French government scholarship run by AEFE for the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs that supports the best non-French baccalaureat holders from the network of French schools abroad to continue their higher education in France. Around 800 foreign students are supported at any one time over five years of study, and about 200 new holders join each year. Applications require pre-selection by the head of the French school abroad and online entry on the dedicated Cascade application, followed by assessment by the French embassy's cultural cooperation service and a selection commission convened by AEFE each May. Selection weighs school results, a coherent orientation project, involvement in school life and extracurricular activity, and motivation for demanding French higher education. Holders receive a family-need-rated monthly allowance of EUR 280 or EUR 860, complementary health cover, and, at the higher rates, round-trip travel and CROUS housing.
